title: Make tmx mutant generation deterministic and digest-pinned (DEC-195 (3))
description: Before any score is used for acceptance, tmx's mutant generation must be deterministic: sorted inputs, seeded, and a mutant-set digest written beside each score. Today two builds of the same source disagree by about 5 mutants (the fresh critical-tier matrix has 418 mutants vs the committed 412, entirely gate.py 205->211, with no source change), so a score cannot be compared across builds. Prove it both ways: two builds of 127461d give the same digest, and a one-line gate.py change moves it. Cited by TS-11 AC0 acceptance.

acceptanceCriteria.text: The same commit and seed produce the same mutant set: tmx sorts its inputs, uses a seeded generator, and records a mutant-set digest beside each score.
Proved both ways: two builds of 127461d give the same digest, and a one-line change to gate.py changes it.

finalSummary: Delivered in opum-ai/test-skills#23. AC1 and AC2 were checked against evidence, not on faith. Implementation: build_specs takes a seed, recorded in tool.seed and used by the per-line sample; every input that feeds the set is sorted (file walk, per-line keys, digest input); the collector writes mutants_digest, a sha256 over the sorted (unique key, mutated source) pairs, printed beside the score by the collector summary and by the score command. Evidence for AC1: gate.py at commit 127461db built twice under different PYTHONHASHSEED gave mutants=452 and digest 9ce8f566010f8707b14e9cf7807d86650452262bd5b4fa78cc1dd4fc48d143d1 both times; an end-to-end two-run collect on a small project produced the same digest 9a4d9dbd387c1901b177186c7e59cbe191761261de4841a2e1d323a2f19a5188 in both matrices with tool.seed 0. Evidence for AC2: a one-line change to that same gate.py (greater-than to greater-or-equal at the max_tests budget check) left the mutant count at 452 and moved the digest to f5a8baafe40be5c5defb18fa109ae993ce858620b1c3488a5e0266ff1ee0f7bf. Validating run 39335975195, on implementation commit adfd071a7a5b3668a35b6aac8f73da19564a5c53: tests (3.9) and tests (3.12) both pass. Local gate: PASS, 79 tests, growth 0. No new test case was added because the suite sits at its max_tests ceiling of 79; the determinism assertion rides the existing mutant test, and raising the ceiling is a separate Article XIII change. lore check reports 11 schema-drift errors on this branch and the identical 26 files / 11 errors on untouched origin/dev, so the drift predates this change; no lore schema export was run.
